{{TierBar}}


'''Crude Parasites''' are a ubiquitous tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. Their Tier is subjective within their Hierarchy and contains 11 Mobs. Killing all of them at least once grants the player the {{AdvancementLink|Crude}}.

=== ''Properties'' ===
Most Crude Parasites have their own custom property values; see their individual pages for more information.
